title: AI & Data Analyst Graduate
description: **Smurfit WestRock** is pleased to offer an exceptional opportunity for a **graduate** to join our **2 year AI & Data analyst Graduate Programme** based at our global headquarters in Dublin, Ireland. **About Us:** We are a **global leader** in sustainable paper and packaging, we operate in 40 countries with over 500 packaging and other facilities as well as 57 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create **sustainable packaging solutions** . Having over 97k employees, and 124,000 hectares of forested land, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate. We pride ourselves on our **diversity** and see the value that brings to our company and strive to create an **inclusive work environment** where employees feel a sense of belonging and are encouraged to be their authentic selves at work. **Overview and Background** The Group Internal Audit Department is seeking a motivated and curious **Graduate AI & Data Analyst** to join the Internal Audit AI & Data Team through a two-year graduate programme. The role provides practical experience across AI agents, analytics, automation, data engineering and other audit initiatives that help address business, risk and control questions. Working alongside experienced team members, the successful candidate will contribute to building and improving AI agents, analysing financial and operational data, developing reporting and data solutions, and improving audit processes. They will initially support wider team projects and take responsibility for smaller, clearly defined assignments with guidance, building towards greater independence as their skills and experience develop. **Key Role Responsibilities:** * Support the development, testing and improvement of AI agents and automation solutions, including evaluating outputs and refining prompts. * Assist with analysing, preparing, transforming and validating financial, operational and other business data to identify patterns, issues and useful insights. * Help develop and maintain scripts, data processes, dashboards and reporting solutions, using and learning tools such as Python, SQL and Power BI. * Work with auditors and colleagues to understand business, risk and control questions and translate requirements into practical tasks and solutions. * Contribute to testing, documentation, peer review and ongoing improvement to help ensure reliable, accurate and well-controlled outputs. * Support wider audit and continuous assurance initiatives, identifying opportunities to use data, AI and automation to improve existing processes. * Take ownership of well-defined tasks or projects with support, communicate progress and raise questions or challenges early. **Candidate Background & Knowledge:** We welcome graduates at the beginning of their career. Relevant knowledge may come from university study, placements, internships or personal projects; prior professional experience in AI or data is not required. * A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering or a related analytical or technical discipline. * Foundational programming skills in Python or another programming language, including the ability to understand, write and troubleshoot basic code, are essential. * A sound understanding of core data analytics concepts, including data preparation, data quality, interpretation and drawing meaningful conclusions from data. * A genuine interest in AI, automation and the use of technology to solve business problems. * Basic knowledge of SQL is desirable but not essential. Training in the team's tools and platforms will be provided. * Projects, placements or coursework demonstrating programming or analytical thinking are welcomed. **Candidate Profile:** * Curious and proactive, with the initiative to explore ideas, ask questions and learn. * Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving, with an interest in how things work. * A clear and confident communicator who can explain ideas and findings to technical and non-technical colleagues. * Collaborative and willing to learn from others while contributing positively to the team. * Careful and methodical, with a commitment to accuracy, data integrity and high-quality work. * Organised and dependable, comfortable owning assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed. * Interested in how business processes, technology and data fit together. * Adaptable, open to feedback and eager to develop new approaches as AI and data technologies evolve. * Fluent English is essential. **What we offer:** * A structured two-year graduate programme with practical experience, mentoring and increasing responsibility * Attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential * Training and learning opportunities across AI, data, analytics and audit * Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence * A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of daily work **Smurfit Westrock** is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Accommodation Assistant

At Dalata, we believe in promoting from within. If you work hard, you can have new opportunities in the future. title: Accountant (Ire)
description: **Job Description** **Job Type:** FTC 12 months **Location:** Dublin (Hybrid working) **Benefits:** €53,000 – 68,000 base salary, 10% Non-Contributory Pension (matched up to a further 2%), Funded Industry Qualifications, Lunch Allowance, Hybrid working . We offer salaries within the stated pay range. Typically, new hires start at the lower end of the range, though recognition of relevant experience and prior service may result in a higher starting salary. **Who are we?** We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures. Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day. **The Role-** We’re recruiting for a financial accountant to join our Financial Reporting team, with responsibility for delivering high ‑ quality monthly management information (MI) and quarterly statutory and regulatory reporting. The role focuses on the review and analysis of financial results, ensuring key drivers and variances are clearly understood and communicated to stakeholders. You will contribute to maintaining a strong control and governance environment, working closely with internal teams and outsourced providers to ensure accurate reporting, effective oversight and compliance with regulatory, reputational and commercial requirements. The position also involves active participation in finance projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the wider finance function. **Key Responsibilities-** * Financial reporting delivery: responsible for preparation, review and analysis of statutory and regulatory financial results, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and aligned with internal and external requirements. * Insight and communication: provide clear, well‑structured written and verbal explanations of financial performance, highlighting key drivers, trends and variances for senior stakeholders. * Control and governance oversight: maintain a strong control environment across outsourced and internal processes, ensuring risks are identified, monitored and appropriately addressed. * Continuous improvement: evaluate existing reporting and control processes, propose enhancements, and support the implementation of more efficient and effective ways of working. * Audit support: coordinate internal and external audit activities, ensuring high‑quality documentation, timely responses and strong audit outcomes. * Cross‑team collaboration: work closely with teams across the wider group, including outsourced accounting providers, to ensure consistency, alignment and effective information flow. * Project involvement: support and represent the reporting team on finance and business projects, shaping requirements, assessing impacts and ensuring business readiness for process or system changes. * Knowledge sharing: support training and capability development within the finance team to embed new processes, systems and best practices. **What We’re Looking For** * Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent) with strong technical grounding. * Post‑qualification experience: ideally 2+ years in financial reporting, audit, insurance or another regulated environment. * Analytical capability: ability to interpret complex data, identify anomalies and articulate the underlying drivers of financial outcomes. * Professional curiosity: a proactive approach to understanding results, investigating issues and seeking clarity. * Strong communication skills: able to present complex information in a clear, concise and structured manner to both finance and non‑finance stakeholders. * Stakeholder engagement: comfortable working with multiple teams, including outsourced providers, and influencing outcomes through collaboration. **We Want To Hire The Whole Version Of You.** We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you. If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best. We’re reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out. **Find Out More About Working At Standard Life** * Guide for Candidates: standardlifeplc.pagetiger.com/guideforcandidates * Find or get answers from our colleagues: www.standardlifeplc.com/careers/talk-to-us Key Competencies * Stakeholder Management * Delivering Results * Communications & Influencing * Commerciality * Analytical skills **We value diversity in our workforce and welcome enquiries from everyone.**

title: Actuarial Analyst,
description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** Join a collaborative team where your ideas and different perspectives are valued. You will apply actuarial thinking to healthcare challenges, working with data and technology to explore questions and turn insights into practical decisions. This opportunity goes beyond a traditional actuarial role and would suit someone who enjoys variety, asks questions and is open to exploring new approaches. You will develop your knowledge and skills alongside experienced colleagues, with support for your continuing actuarial education and qualifications. Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model. The start date for this role is 27th July, 2027. **Primary Responsibilities** * Analyse revenue, claims and membership data to identify trends, explain changes and support forecasting and business decisions * Develop expense projections and unpaid claim reserve estimates, exploring assumptions and discussing findings with colleagues * Translate analysis into clear reports and practical recommendations, explaining technical findings to non-technical audiences * Collaborate with colleagues to investigate emerging questions, challenge assumptions constructively and explore new approaches to analysis and reporting You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience * Preparation for, or successful completion of, Actuarial examinations * Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, calculations, charts, and graphs * Demonstrated willingness to learn new tools and approaches, seek feedback, and apply learning to unfamiliar challenges * Proven ability to communicate analytical findings effectively, listen to diverse perspectives, and adapt communication for technical and non-technical audiences * Demonstrated curiosity and creative problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives, and develop innovative solutions *Examples of relevant experience may be drawn from academic studies, projects, volunteering, internships, or previous employment.* **Preferred Qualifications** * Demonstrated familiarity with the finance or healthcare industry * Demonstrated familiarity working within a corporate environment **Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application. Work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.** *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: Optum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age, race, and membership of the Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by law. Optum is a drug-free workplace. © 2026 Optum Services (Ireland) Limited. All rights reserved.* #BBMEMEA

title: Actuarial Expert
description: The Allianz Group is a global financial services provider with services predominantly in the insurance and asset management business. Allianz SE, the parent company, is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Allianz has established a specialist Branch, Allianz SE Dublin Reinsurance Branch. The branch's premises are at Allianz House, Elmpark, Merrion Road, Dublin 4. **Job Description** We are looking for an Actuarial Expert to join our Corporate Actuarial team at Allianz Re in Dublin. Reporting to the Head of P&C Reserving, you will be part of a small, collaborative and highly professional team, fully integrated with all aspects of quarterly and annual reporting under IFRS 17 and Solvency II. This is an excellent opportunity for a nearly or newly qualified actuary to deepen their technical expertise in a global reinsurance environment, working with modern tools including ResQ, Unify, SAS and advanced Excel. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform reserving on IFRS 17 and Solvency II bases across assigned global reinsurance segments * Carry out underwriting risk capital calculations as part of the entity's Solvency II internal capital model * Contribute to quarterly roll-forward exercises and annual deep-dive reserve reviews * Support experience analysis and assumption setting for Life & Health and/or Property & Casualty lines * Assess reserve adequacy, monitor trends and emerging risks * Perform stress testing, sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling from both reserving and risk capital perspectives * Identify opportunities for model improvements and support their implementation * Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders across the business What We're Looking For **Required Qualifications & Experience** * Close to completing (or recently completed) fellowship of a recognised actuarial body (e.g. IFoA) * University degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline * 3+ years' experience in IFRS and/or Solvency II reserving, local regulatory reserving, or capital modelling in a reinsurance or insurance environment * Good understanding of IFRS 17 concepts; practical experience (e.g. in IFRS 17 testing or development) is a strong advantage Technical Skills * Programming and database proficiency, SAS and SQL are essential * Strong MS Excel skills including VBA and Power Query * Experience with DFA, risk capital or cashflow modelling would be an advantage Personal Attributes * Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail * Clear and confident communicator, both written and verbal * Comfortable working independently and managing competing priorities * A collaborative team player who thrives in an international working environment * Structured approach to complex actuarial problems **Responsibilities** At Allianz Re, we are committed to embracing innovation and the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence to enhance our work. We particularly value candidates who demonstrate: * Curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new tools and methodologies * Awareness of AI-powered tools and their application in actuarial and data analysis * An interest in data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement What We Offer * Study support for actuarial professional examinations * Exposure to a diverse, global reinsurance portfolio * A supportive, close-knit team environment with direct access to senior leadership * Opportunities for professional growth within the wider Allianz Group * Modern tools and technology to support your work Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. Join us **. Let's care for tomorrow.**

title: Animal Care Asistant
description: **Animal Care Assistant** **Beechwood Vets and Cherrywood Vets | Dublin** **Full-Time, Permanent** **Salary €30,000 to €32,000 DOE** **Turn Your Passion for Animals Into a Career** If you've chosen animal care because you genuinely love working with pets and want to make a difference every day, this could be the perfect job for you. We're looking for an Animal Care Assistant to join our team at Beechwood Vets, with occasional support provided to our nearby sister practice, Cherrywood Vets. This is an exciting opportunity to become part of two highly respected small animal practices where you'll work alongside experienced veterinary surgeons and nurses, gain valuable hands-on experience, and play an important role in the care of pets across Dublin. Whether you're newly qualified or already have experience working with animals, you'll be joining a supportive team that values learning, development, and exceptional patient care. **A Role Where Every Day Matters** As an Animal Care Assistant, you'll be involved in every stage of a patient's journey through the practice. One moment you might be helping a nervous dog settle in for surgery, preparing a recovery area, or assisting with patient care. The next, you'll be welcoming clients at reception, answering phone calls, helping coordinate appointments, or supporting the clinical team behind the scenes. This variety makes the role incredibly rewarding. You'll build relationships with pets and their owners while developing practical skills and experience within a busy veterinary environment. It's the ideal opportunity for someone who wants to be surrounded by animals every day and build a long-term career within veterinary practice. **What You'll Be Doing** Your role will include: * Caring for hospitalised patients by ensuring they are comfortable, clean, and receiving the attention they need. * Maintaining high standards of cleanliness throughout the practice, including patient wards, kennels, consultation rooms, and clinical areas. * Supporting veterinary surgeons and nurses with the preparation of equipment, treatment areas, and patient care. * Feeding, exercising, and monitoring patients while ensuring their wellbeing remains the top priority. * Welcoming clients, answering calls, managing enquiries, and helping create a positive experience for every visitor to the practice. * Supporting the wider team with administration, organisation, and the smooth day-to-day running of the clinic. **Why Join Beechwood Vets?** Located in the heart of Ranelagh, Beechwood Veterinary Clinic is a busy and growing small animal practice with excellent transport links via the Luas and Dublin Bus routes. Our team work collaboratively to deliver excellent patient care. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of medical and surgical cases while working within a modern, well-equipped environment featuring advanced diagnostics, ultrasound, and in-house laboratory facilities. Most importantly, you'll be joining a friendly team where people genuinely enjoy coming to work and supporting one another. Importantly, there are no out-of-hours requirements, no Sunday working, and no Bank Holiday commitments, helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance. **Supporting Our Cherrywood Team** While your role will primarily be based at Beechwood, there may be occasions where you'll support our nearby team at Cherrywood Veterinary Clinic. Cherrywood has been caring for pets and their families in South Dublin for over 30 years and has built an outstanding reputation for compassionate veterinary care. The clinic offers modern facilities, a loyal client base, and a close-knit team environment where everyone works together to provide the highest standards of patient care. Working across both clinics gives you the opportunity to learn from a wider team, gain additional experience, and expand your skills within two successful practices. **Who We're Looking For** We're looking for someone with a genuine passion for animals and a positive, proactive attitude. You'll be someone who enjoys working with people as much as pets, takes pride in maintaining high standards, and remains calm and compassionate in a busy clinical environment. Strong communication skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively are all essential qualities for success in this role. **Essential Requirement** Applicants must hold a QQI qualification in Animal Care (or an equivalent recognised qualification). **Experience** Previous experience working in a veterinary practice, animal care environment, kennel, rescue centre, or similar setting would be advantageous, but it is not essential. We welcome applications from newly qualified candidates who are eager to begin their career in veterinary care. **Working Hours** This is a full-time position working 40 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled between 7:30am and 7:00pm on a rota basis and will be provided in advance. You'll typically work a mix of early and later shifts throughout the week. The role also includes participation in a Saturday rota. Saturday shifts are half days only, with time off in lieu provided. **Importantly, There Are** No out-of-hours shifts No Sunday working No Bank Holiday commitments Giving you the opportunity to enjoy a healthy work-life balance whilst building your veterinary career. **Benefits (Subject To Pro Rata)** We offer a competitive salary along with great benefits, including: * Leave: Annual Leave, Birthday Leave, Paid Maternity, Paternity, Bereavement, & Sick Leave * Wellbeing: Cycle to Work Scheme, EAP Access, Free Flu Jabs, Discounts (Retail & Virtual Gym), & Access to Company Programmes (LGBTQ+, Wellbeing, etc.) * Career Development: Career Progression, Leadership Academy, Paid Professional Memberships (VCI & VDS), Annual Pay Reviews * Financial Support: Employer Pension Contributions, Discounted Staff Pet Veterinary Fees **Begin Your Veterinary Career With Us** This is much more than an animal care role. It's an opportunity to join a team that genuinely cares, develop valuable clinical experience, work alongside experienced veterinary professionals, and build a rewarding long-term career helping animals every day. If you're passionate about animal welfare and looking for a role where you can learn, grow, and make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you. €30,000 - €32,000 a year **€30,000 to €32,000 DOE** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Assistant Accountant
description: Barden is delighted to partner with a client of ours in Dublin City Centre as they look to hire an Assistant Accountant. This role goes beyond a traditional accounts position, giving ownership across transactional finance, reconciliations, month-end, and reporting. title: Assistant Underwriter - Commercial Insurance (FTC)
description: **Job Description** We have a new interim role available (12 months FTC) to join our Dublin office as an Assistant Underwriter. This is a key role within our commercial insurance team where you will contribute to the achievement of business and corporate goals relating to renewal retention, rate, exposure, service, and producer/client relations. operational functions. **Key Responsibilities** * Supporting the underwriting process from pre-renewal / submission stage right through to documentation issuance post bind. * Maintenance and management of renewal lists. * Carrying out allocated pre-renewal tasks. * Upon receiving instructions, ensure timely action to allow the premium to be booked and policy documentation to be issued. * Manage mid-term actions for allocated accounts, liaising with all relevant teams to ensure administrative matters are handled efficiently. * Prepare risk referrals and seek approval from the appropriate authority holder as necessary if outside your underwriting authority or where assistance is required. * Managing our survey process. * Maintain knowledge of all relevant product lines, appetite, and policy wordings. * Follow and align with underwriting processes and protocols as mandated by the Product Line for your portfolio of accounts. **Qualifications** * Experience within title: Customer Service Representative
description: **About FoodSight** Good food goes in the bin every day. We’re the ones stopping it. Commercial kitchens throw out food they bought, prepped and cooked, and nobody counts it. Across food service that’s 290 million tonnes a year. Food loss and waste drives up to 10% of global emissions, almost five times aviation. We built Scrappy: a scale and a camera that sit over the bin and see every gram. Our AI names it, weighs it and prices it in euro. Then we tell the chef what to change tomorrow. Waste is down 56% at Indeed. A head chef at Sky calls it part of his kit, “as much as my knife or my oven”. We’re a high-impact team, looking after some of Europe’s largest commercial kitchens across Ireland, the UK and DACH. Everyone here owns something whole. Everything you build lands in a working kitchen, and you can count what it saved in kilos, euro and carbon. **Our four values** * Make our customers’ lives easier. Chefs work a gruelling job. We remove friction. We never add it. * Act like an owner. No brief needed. Our money, our numbers, our results. * Be comfortable in the uncomfortable. Form a view. Ask the hard question. Change your mind when the data does. * Be good company. Some days are difficult. Be kind. Laugh often. **How we work** * Monday to Thursday in our Dublin office, whole team, same days. Friday is deep work, wherever you do it best. A day on a customer site counts as an office day. * Meetings are 25 or 50 minutes, with a purpose, an agenda and next steps. Or they don’t happen. * Written first. Chat for quick questions, docs for decisions. Bad news early, with the numbers and a plan. * AI is on by default for drafts, research and analysis. You own the output. **Be the person chefs call when Scrappy needs a hand.** Our customers are busy kitchens. When something isn’t working, they need a fast, friendly answer from someone who knows the product. You’ll be that person. You’ll keep every site running smoothly, so the team can focus on cutting waste, not fixing kit. * **Location:** Dublin office, Mon-Thu. Friday remote. Regular kitchen visits across Dublin. * **Reports to:** Operations Manager * **Works with:** Customer success, sales and product What you’ll do * Answer customer questions by email, phone and chat. Same day, every day. * Fix the common issues yourself: Scrappy setup, scales, cameras, Wi-Fi, app logins. * Visit kitchens to install, check in and train new staff on the bin. * Keep every site live. Spot a quiet scale or a missing report before the chef does. * Log every issue clearly in our CRM, and pass bugs to product with the detail they need. * Turn repeat questions into short guides and FAQs, so customers can help themselves. What you’ll bring * Some customer-facing experience, part-time and student jobs count: retail, hospitality, a café or a busy kitchen. No office experience needed. * Calm with a frustrated customer. You listen first, then fix it. * Comfortable with tech. You’ll happily restart a router or pair a device and figure out why it’s not working. * Clear, short writing. Customers should understand your reply on a phone, mid-service. * Organised. Nothing gets dropped, and every issue has a next step. * A full driving licence, or easy travel to sites around Dublin. * Bonus: kitchen or hospitality experience, or German. Your first 90 days * **Learn (days 1-30):** shadow the team, visit customer kitchens, learn Scrappy inside out. Answering customers on your own by day 14. * **Own (days 31-60):** run the support inbox, your own site visits and check-ins. * **Deliver (days 61-90):** the top 10 customer guides live, and fewer repeat questions every week. The project (step 6) You get three real customer emails: a scale that’s gone quiet, a confused new chef and an unhappy head of catering. Write your replies and walk us through what you’d do next. 20 minutes to present, 20 minutes of us playing the customer. We look for clear replies, the right questions and how you stay calm under pressure. What you get * A real first step into tech and customer success, with training from day one. * Time in some of Europe’s biggest kitchens, not just behind a screen. * A product with published proof: 56% waste cut at Indeed. * A clear path to customer success manager as we grow. **How we hire** Six steps. Same questions and the same scorecard for every candidate. Each step turns around in 1-3 days. - CV - two minutes to read. Show outcomes and numbers, not duties. - AI screening - a short structured interview in your own time. A person reviews every result. - Phone screen - with the hiring manager. Motivation, your numbers, how you work. - In-person panel - two or three of us, structured questions scored against our traits. - CEO meeting - values and ambition. Where you want to be in two years. Both sides decide. - Project presentation - a real problem from the role. You present, we push back. We test thinking, not polish. **This isn’t for everyone** If you need a brief to start, want it perfect before it ships, or want a quiet, predictable week, this isn’t the place. Better you know now.

title: Graduate Analyst – Portfolio Monitoring Unit
description: **Company Overview** KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. title: Graduate Architect (Cork)

title: Junior Supply Chain Consultant - September 2027
description: **Job Description** **About the role** **Kickstart your consulting career!** Get ready to launch your career in consulting, and join us! You’ll have a spot in our supply chain training boot camp at the beginning of September. You’ll sharpen your consulting expertise alongside fellow new starters from around the globe. Our training program covers everything from essential soft skills to advanced supply chain management to becoming a kick-ass Supply Chain Consultant. Afterwards, you're ready to start on one of our running projects. **What can you do at Bluecrux?** * You'll start immediately in a visible, autonomous role as a project member in one of our running value chain projects in industries such as life sciences, chemicals, food and beverages, and manufacturing. * You'll see yourself working on and contributing to the main project phases. Here's an idea of what to expect: + Analyze and Optimize: You will always analyze, map, and conduct existing Supply Chain and Operations business processes. + Collaborate: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and make a real impact. Think about preparing and conducting project interviews to understand the client's needs better. You will become aware of the customer organization and be part of the change in their organization and ways of working. + Track and report: You'll track KPIs and report them accurately to the customer project team, ensuring clear, actionable insights. + Document and deliver: You create the most important customer and project deliverables, such as top-notch project notes, guides and training material. * Here’s how you’ll continuously be making an impact: + Tell us, what’s your flavour? All of our projects share a common transformation mission, and once you join a project, you’ll be introduced to different extra layers of specialisation to add value. We will encourage you to explore and accelerate in Technology, Process knowledge, Data or Change Management. **Job Requirements** **About you** * You will graduate before September 2027 and want to start your career at the beginning of September 2027. * You see yourself thriving in the world of value chain transformation and are interested in how Technology, Business Processes, Data Analytics, and Change management create a flourishing ecosystem of solutions. * You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind! * Above all, we believe in your potential: + You can demonstrate profound logical reasoning, and you are resourceful in detailing solutions and considerate about their consequences. + You're a team worker and player who can perform well without much supervision and who is committed to your own objectives. + You're open to feedback and always look for ways to enhance collaboration. + You like to be challenged daily, show proactive ownership and, above all, thrive in a fast-paced environment. * Some hard skills: + Ideally, you have had an introduction to Supply Chain Processes in a minor or major within a master’s degree program, such as business engineering, civil engineering—operational research, applied economics, mechanical engineering or an MBA program. + You are fluent in English, the official work language in all of our offices. Mastery of any other language is a definite plus. + Willingness and eligibility to travel globally and to work in a hybrid working model. **Why join us?** * A kickstart to your career through our Supply Chain Bootcamp training program, at the beginning of September. You will learn the ins & outs of Supply Chain Management: Demand Planning, S&OP and Financial Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Master Data Management, Supply Chain Modelling and Planning Tools. This will allow you to onboard into our projects with a backpack full of expertise & skills! * We know you by your first name, and don't let titles or levels withhold us from being truly aware of your talents. * You'll work on international projects and travel to client sites. From the start, you will gain exposure and recognition for every achievement at Bluecrux. * A Great Place To Work with lots of growth opportunities. We encourage initiative, so you’ll learn a lot quickly. Sometimes, you’ll fail fast, but we’ll help you to get up. We’ll enhance your personal and professional skills, and you can count on a great, supportive team of hands-on, inspiring and enthusiastic supply chain colleagues. * Team events and fun include yearly Bluecrux weekends, last Friday meetings with drinks, team building, and sports activities. * Enjoy a flexible & hybrid work environment, combining remote work, office presence (in our brand new office!) and onsite client visits. * A competitive salary package, bonus program, net allowances, a smartphone with phone subscription and other benefits (such as a fridge full of drinks & healthy snacks). **About us** At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

title: Legal & Government Policy Analyst (AI Training)

* Identify factual errors, logical flaws, or misleading interpretations in AI outputs * Assess whether AI responses appropriately handle nuance across legislation, case law, compliance, and public regulatory topics * No prior AI experience required **Nice to Have** * Background in law, political science, public administration, or a related field * Experience with legal research, compliance work, or government operations in Ireland or the EU * Familiarity with GDPR, DPC enforcement, Irish data protection or financial regulation * Paralegal, legal assistant, or policy research experience * Knowledge of Irish constitutional law or the common law tradition **Why Join Us** * Work on cutting-edge AI projects shaping how AI handles legal and government content * Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work when it suits you * Collaborate with top research labs and a global community of subject matter experts * Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and meaningful impact * Build expertise at the intersection of AI and law — a rapidly growing and influential field * Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity Arup Ireland are seeking talented students to join our Roads and Streets team. We look for students who are ready to jump into the professional world; diverse individuals with inquisitive minds and a desire to challenge. You will work alongside skilled professionals and contribute to the success of real projects. You will also enjoy learning sessions with technical experts within your team, working on local projects and all kinds of social events. A role in the Roads and Streets team will include design and coordination, often liaising with other multi-disciplinary contributors to projects. You will be required to deliver projects to the required technical standards in a timely manner, reporting to the team leader or project manager as appropriate. Is this role right for you? Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. title: Sales Operations Support Executive
description: **Who are we?** Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden. Based in any of our Dublin offices, Howden Ireland are delighted to have a vacancy as an Sales Operations Support Executive for our Commercial book of business that will be an integral part of our wider Commercial sales team. **About The Role** The Sales Operations Support Executive will support the Sales Operations Manager with the day-to-day coordination, administration and data management activities that keep the sales function running efficiently. The position is focused on accurate data, effective follow-up, timely lead allocation and reliable reporting. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Sales Operations Manager and wider Sales Team, helping to coordinate routine operational activities and requests. * Maintain accurate and complete CRM records for leads, prospects, opportunities and activities. Follow up with sales colleagues where records are incomplete, overdue or require correction. * Complete regular data updates, cleansing, deduplication and validation to ensure records are consistent, current and suitable for reporting and follow-up. * Research and add appropriate business information to prospect and lead records, such as company details, sector, location, contact information and other agreed fields. * Receive, review and allocate leads to the appropriate sales colleague or regional office in line with agreed allocation rules, ownership criteria and service levels. * Monitor the progress and status of allocated leads, issue reminders for outstanding updates and escalate aged or unworked leads to the Sales Operations Manager where required. * Support report creation, dashboards and trackers covering lead volumes, allocation, activity, pipeline status, data completeness and agreed performance measures. * Assist the sales team with general administrative duties, including preparing lists, updating trackers, coordinating information and responding to routine operational queries. * Provide administrative support for sales and marketing campaigns, including preparing and validating target lists, enriching campaign data, coordinating lead uploads and allocations, tracking responses and outcomes, and maintaining accurate campaign records and reports. * Follow agreed procedures and maintain clear records to support auditability, internal controls, data protection and Howden Group compliance requirements. * Identify recurring data or process issues and suggest practical improvements to templates, workflows, controls and CRM usage. * Complete other reasonable sales operations and administrative tasks as required. **About You** * Previous experience in sales administration, sales operations, data administration, customer support or a similar coordination role is preferred. * Experience in commercial insurance or financial services would be beneficial but is not essential. * A relevant insurance qualification, including CIP, is desirable but not required for this primarily administrative position. * Intermediate Excel capability, including filters, lookups, tables and basic reporting, would be an advantage. * Familiarity with CRM or policy administration systems (e.g. Acturis). * APA qualification or willingness to work towards insurance accreditation * Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. * High level of accuracy and attention to detail when working with data. * Experience using a CRM system or maintaining customer, prospect or sales data. * Confidence following up with colleagues to obtain missing information and close data-quality gaps. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * A practical, proactive and collaborative approach to supporting a busy sales team. * Awareness of data protection, confidentiality and the importance of accurate record keeping. **About Howden Ireland** Howden Ireland is part of Howden, the global insurance intermediary group, and has over 600 employees across 28 local offices advising clients on their commercial insurance, personal insurance, health insurance, life and pensions and mortgage requirements. Our success is primarily down to the incredible people we employ. For more information, please visit **About Us | Howden Ireland (howdengroup.com** **What do we offer in return?** A Career That You Define. At Howden, We Value Diversity – There Is No One Howden Type. Instead, We’re Looking For Individuals Who Share The Same Values As Us * Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new * We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges * We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond **Reasonable adjustments** We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*. If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require. * Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more. Permanent

title: Service Technician
description: **Job Title:** Equipment Service Technician **Role Type:** Full Time, Permanent **Location:** Swords, Dublin Harper Finley Recruitment have partnered with a well-established medical device supplier to recruit an Equipment Service Technician in Swords, Co. Dublin. No previous medical or clinical experience is required, as full training will be provided. This is hands-on Service Technician will join a technical team, carrying out repairs, maintenance and testing on a range of specialist medical equipment. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a background in electrical repairs, electronics or equipment servicing to apply their technical skills in a new environment. Full product training will be provided, with the opportunity to develop your expertise, gain new skills and build a long-term career in an amazing field. **Duties & Responsibilities:** * Inspect returned equipment for damage, wear and faults. * Carry out basic repairs, servicing and routine maintenance. * Troubleshoot electrical, electronic and mechanical issues. * Provide troubleshooting support over the phone. * Test equipment to ensure it functions correctly and safely. * Replace approved parts and faulty components. * Clean, prepare and process equipment for reissue. * Record repairs, test results and maintenance activities accurately. * Maintain tools, testing equipment and spare parts. * Identify recurring faults and escalate complex technical issues. * Work with warehouse and service teams to meet operational priorities. **Requirements:** * Hands-on experience diagnosing faults and repairing electrical, electronic or electromechanical equipment. * Good understanding of electronic components, power supplies, wiring and basic circuitry. * Experience using hand tools and diagnostic equipment, such as multimeters. * Ability to follow technical manuals and testing procedures, with strong attention to detail. * Good computer skills and a methodical approach to technical work. * A relevant technical qualification (NFQ Level 5 or 6, or equivalent) or recognised technical apprenticeship would be an advantage. * Experience in equipment servicing, preventative maintenance or component replacement is desirable, with medical-device experience considered a plus. **Benefits & Additional Details:** * Base salary of €35,000 - €44,000 * Private Health Insurance * Monday to Friday 9 – 5.30pm There is currently no visa, or relocation support available with this a role, so it is open to candidates with EU/EEA passport or Stamp 4 Visa.

description: Involves physical, online and telephone contact with external/internal customers within functional area and station completing any related operational and administration tasks. We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Special Services Representative. This position will be warehouse based supporting the VWGIE contract **Shift available** 02:00 – 10.00 – Tuesday to Saturday x1 **Who We Are** FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. title: Speculative Careers in Rail - Ireland and Northern Ireland
description: **Job Description** **What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?** At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. To find out more about our Rail business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: https://www.wsp.com/en-GB/hubs/transit **Help shape a smarter, safer and greener rail future.** WSP’s Rail team is growing in Ireland and Northern Ireland, and we’re building a pipeline of talent across multiple disciplines. If you’re curious, collaborative and motivated by meaningful infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you. **Where you could fit** We welcome interest from candidates at Graduate, Engineer/Senior, Principal, and Associate/Associate Director levels across areas such as: * Rail Operations & Planning (capacity, timetabling, operational modelling) * Systems Engineering & Safety Assurance * Telecoms & Digital Systems/Digital Engineering * MEP (Rail Stations & Depots) * Project & Design Management Our multi disciplinary teams integrate these capabilities to deliver end to end solutions for clients across the public and private sectors—optimising network capacity, improving passenger experience and advancing decarbonisation. **What You’ll Do** * Contribute to concept and feasibility studies, detailed design and assurance for new and existing rail assets * Apply data driven methods (e.g., simulation, digital engineering) to improve safety, reliability and performance * Collaborate in multi disciplinary teams, engaging stakeholders and delivery partners * Support work winning through proposals, thought leadership and client relationships * Coach junior colleagues and share best practice as part of a supportive, learning culture What you’ll bring * Relevant degree (or equivalent experience) in engineering, transport planning or related discipline * Experience in one or more of the disciplines listed above; rail consultancy or client/contractor background welcome * A proactive, delivery focused mindset, with strong teamwork and communication skills * Working knowledge of Irish and/or UK rail standards (desirable) * Progress toward professional accreditation/chartership (or already attained) **What’s In It For You** * Impactful work on complex, high profile programmes that shape mobility and communities * Growth & progression through professional development and chartership support * Inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and you can bring your full self to work If you’re excited about contributing to a smarter, safer and greener rail future—and want to be part of a team that leads the way—we’d love to hear from you. Express your interest today and explore where a career in Rail at WSP could take you. **Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.** Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. **With us, you can. Apply today.** **About Us** We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?** **Work-life balance** At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community. Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK. **Inclusivity & Belonging** We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity. **Health & Wellbeing** We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme. Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package. **Flex your time** To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day. We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you. **Your development** We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership. **#WeAreWSP** *Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*
